concept: Fargate: serverless containers with no instance management
tests: Choosing a launch type for containers with no EC2 capacity management, paying for task vCPU and memory.
expected: AWS Fargate: serverless container execution, pay only for requested vCPU and memory. Triggers: "eliminate EC2 capacity management", "pay only for vCPU and memory their tasks consume".
why_not: ECS EC2 launch type and self-managed Kubernetes require managing instances; Reserved Instances are an EC2 pricing model, not serverless.
